summary: Metric annotations appearing on unrelated org dashboards after retention-tier compaction
description:
Issue summary: After a scheduled retention-tier compaction run that moved warm-tier annotations to cold storage, multiple metric annotations (alerts, notes, manual markers) started appearing on dashboards for orgs that did not create them. The annotations show up on historical time ranges and are clickable, linking to the original annotation text but with the wrong org/route metadata.

Impact: Customer-visible corruption of dashboard context for BrightFin Analytics (enterprise). Several of their dashboards displayed annotations attributed to other tenants which is causing confusion during on-call and is a potential compliance/data-isolation concern. Affected dashboards are used in production monitoring—no model inference requests were affected, only console/observability.

Environment: Production us-east region. Retention compaction job initiated 2026-03-11 02:10 UTC during low-traffic window.

Steps to reproduce: 
1) Open BrightFin Analytics org console -> select historical dashboard with time range covering 2025-11 to 2026-02.
2) Enable annotations layer -> observe unexpected annotations attributed to other orgs (IDs visible in the hovercard).
3) Click annotation -> annotation text and created_by fields show a different tenant and user.
4) Query annotation index with the annotation ID -> returns index entry with "global_id" and missing tenant_namespace field.

Logs / Evidence: 
- Retention compaction job logs: retention-service/compactor-2026-03-11.log lines 345-412 reference "migrated annotation_id=ann_8f3b" with no tenant key.
- Dashboard server traces (trace IDs): d3f2a1b4-0e11-4c95-91a9-9f1a2f7c3b5c shows annotation join at 2026-03-11T02:35:21Z.
- Example annotation IDs observed by customer: ann_8f3b, ann_4c9d, ann_fa12.
- Slack thread: #support (pin): https://slack.redwood.com/archives/C02SUPPORT/p03a3bcd123

Initial hypothesis: The compaction job kept global annotation IDs but dropped tenant_namespace while building the cold index, causing index lookups by ID to fall back to the first matching global entry (cross-org). This happened only for annotations that were >90 days and created before an internal index schema change (2025-10).

Workaround applied: We temporarily disabled cold-index annotation lookups for tenant-scoped dashboards and forced the dashboard-service to prefer live tenant-scoped annotation joins. For affected dashboards we triggered a reindex of annotations for BrightFin via admin tool (admin.reindex_annotations --org brightfin --range 2025-08-2026-02). This removed cross-tenant annotations from their dashboards while we investigate.

Investigation notes: 
- Confirmed compaction code path removed tenant_namespace during a schema migration in the compacter (missing mapping in PR #382).
- Backfill plan created to rehydrate tenant_namespace for affected annotation records by joining compacted records to archive store (S3) and original DB snapshots.
- Estimated affected annotation count: ~7.4k globally, ~120 for BrightFin.

Resolution summary: Patch merged to retention-service to preserve tenant_namespace when compacting annotations (PR: github.com/redwood-inference/retention-service/pull/482). A targeted reindex job reattached correct tenant pointers for BrightFin and three other affected enterprise orgs. Changes deployed to prod-us-east 2026-03-13 04:20 UTC. Post-deploy checks show annotation index entries contain tenant_namespace and dashboards no longer surface cross-tenant annotations.

Follow-up actions: 
- Run full backfill across all regions to ensure no remaining missing tenant_namespace fields (scheduled 2026-03-16).
- Add integration test in retention-service pipeline to assert tenant scoping is preserved for annotations during compaction.
- Postmortem to be authored and linked to this ticket.
